parts.answer: SB-AX17-2026-09 requires temporary hepatic monitoring enhancement, requiring baseline hepatic laboratory values with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21. For ALT/AST >3x ULN, it requires medical review. For Bilirubin >2x ULN, it requires urgent review. For mild isolated change below trigger, it requires a repeat test. It notes that the bulletin does not change the approved German renal starting dose of 25 mg once daily for moderate renal impairment.
